## Checks and assumptions

The query retrieved **16 of 16** screened development records (100% relative recall). These records helped build the strategy, so this is not independent validation or a sensitivity estimate; there was no held-out set. The school and outcome blocks each retained all 16 known records and had 0 relevant records in their respective fresh 30-record loss samples.

I interpreted eligible consumption outcomes broadly to include dietary intake, eating behavior or choice, food preference, and diet quality. I treated adolescents and school students across grades as potentially eligible, so age/grade remains a screening criterion rather than a required query block. The scope proceeded under your instruction not to pause for questions; those assumptions are documented in the audit.

Three internal critic rounds were completed, including correction of two eating-behavior spelling variants. This is internal QA, not PRESS peer review. **Have an information specialist conduct PRESS peer review before using the strategy.**
